name: Base indigo ground plate
description: Opaque deep indigo-to-violet vertical ground. The only intentionally non-transparent asset in the pack; everything else composites on top.
notes: Place first. Fills the full trim + bleed area.

name: Upper-left violet colour field
description: Soft large-scale colour field (upper-left violet colour field). Tonal mass only — contains no linework and never competes with typography.
notes: Composite with normal blending at full opacity.

description: Soft large-scale colour field (lower-right electric blue field). Tonal mass only — contains no linework and never competes with typography.
notes: Composite with normal blending at full opacity.

name: Volumetric nebula texture
description: Multi-octave fractal-noise cloud layer tinted to the violet/blue palette. Supplies the painterly atmospheric depth of the concept.
notes: SVG filter primitive. Figma rasterises feTurbulence on import — see README 'Known import caveats'. Screen blend, 58% opacity.

name: Depth vignette pair
description: Vertical + radial vignette that seats the composition and keeps the page edges from floating.
notes: Two stacked gradients; keep together.

name: Reading-zone quiet mask
description: Multiply mask that lowers contrast behind the title and footer bands without crushing them to black. Enforces the quiet -> energy -> quiet rhythm.
notes: Apply ABOVE all illustration layers but BELOW typography. Never remove: this is what keeps text legible.

name: Dominant luminous sweep
description: Primary gesture of the composition. Passes behind the hero. Glow pass + core stroke, matching the project's existing WaveGlow/WaveCore convention.
notes: Screen blend. Safe-zone verified: clears all protected text bands.

name: Right inbound cyan filament
description: Terminates behind the hero logo. Glow pass + core stroke, matching the project's existing WaveGlow/WaveCore convention.
notes: Screen blend. Safe-zone verified: clears all protected text bands.

name: Left inbound blue filament
description: Balances the dominant sweep on the left. Glow pass + core stroke, matching the project's existing WaveGlow/WaveCore convention.
notes: Screen blend. Safe-zone verified: clears all protected text bands.

name: Upper supporting arc
description: Quiet transitional arc between subtitle and hero. Glow pass + core stroke, matching the project's existing WaveGlow/WaveCore convention.
notes: Screen blend. Safe-zone verified: clears all protected text bands.

name: Lower-right ascending filament
description: Lifts energy out of the footer field. Glow pass + core stroke, matching the project's existing WaveGlow/WaveCore convention.
notes: Screen blend. Safe-zone verified: clears all protected text bands.

name: Far parallax echo
description: Heavily blurred background echo; creates parallax depth. Glow pass + core stroke, matching the project's existing WaveGlow/WaveCore convention.
notes: Screen blend. Safe-zone verified: clears all protected text bands.

name: Central computational bloom
description: Three deliberately offset luminous lobes forming the energy zone around the Python focal point. Offsetting prevents it reading as a plain circle.
notes: Sits directly behind the hero logo. Warm lobe carries the only Python-yellow in the pack.

name: Upper-left violet bloom
description: Soft diffuse luminous mass (upper-left). Pure tonal light, no linework.
notes: Screen blend. Safe to sit under typography — adds no edges.

name: Lower-right blue bloom
description: Soft diffuse luminous mass (lower-right). Pure tonal light, no linework.
notes: Screen blend. Safe to sit under typography — adds no edges.

name: Mid-field cyan diffusion
description: Soft diffuse luminous mass (middle). Pure tonal light, no linework.
notes: Screen blend. Safe to sit under typography — adds no edges.

name: Footer grounding glow
description: Soft diffuse luminous mass (lower). Pure tonal light, no linework.
notes: Screen blend. Safe to sit under typography — adds no edges.

name: Core halo point cloud
description: Irregular data-point shell orbiting the focal zone, denser to the right. Never scatters inside the logo radius.
notes: Data-science point-cloud language. Keep with energy_ring assets.

name: Lower-left dispersal stream
description: Particles escaping the core toward the lower left — the visual 'energy disperses' step of the density rhythm.
notes: Directional; do not mirror without redrawing.

name: Upper quiet star field
description: Distributed light specks across the upper field. Sized for print: no sub-0.4pt dots that would vanish on press.
notes: Safe-zone filtered at generation time.

name: Mid-field dust
description: Distributed light specks across the middle field. Sized for print: no sub-0.4pt dots that would vanish on press.
notes: Safe-zone filtered at generation time.

name: Footer light specks
description: Distributed light specks across the lower field. Sized for print: no sub-0.4pt dots that would vanish on press.
notes: Safe-zone filtered at generation time.

name: Foreground sharp specks
description: Crisp near-field highlights intended to sit IN FRONT of the hero logo. This is what stops the logo reading as pasted on.
notes: Z-order above the Python logo, below typography. Deliberate, hand-placed.

name: Foreground bokeh discs
description: Out-of-focus foreground discs providing true depth separation.
notes: Keep very low opacity; these read as lens depth.

name: Left signal trace
description: Circuit-echo trace with terminal node. Elegant, secondary, deliberately low-contrast engineering hint.
notes: Component-local viewBox — position manually in Figma. Keep opacity low; these must stay subordinate to the waves and the core.

name: Right signal trace
description: Two-segment trace pair, staggered for rhythm. Elegant, secondary, deliberately low-contrast engineering hint.
notes: Component-local viewBox — position manually in Figma. Keep opacity low; these must stay subordinate to the waves and the core.

name: Chip outline accent
description: Chip-outline hint; the most literal motif in the pack — use sparingly. Elegant, secondary, deliberately low-contrast engineering hint.
notes: Component-local viewBox — position manually in Figma. Keep opacity low; these must stay subordinate to the waves and the core.

name: Connector edge fragment
description: Connector rail with alternating pin heights. Elegant, secondary, deliberately low-contrast engineering hint.
notes: Component-local viewBox — position manually in Figma. Keep opacity low; these must stay subordinate to the waves and the core.

name: Measurement tick row
description: Instrumentation tick row; every third tick is taller. Elegant, secondary, deliberately low-contrast engineering hint.
notes: Component-local viewBox — position manually in Figma. Keep opacity low; these must stay subordinate to the waves and the core.

name: Primary broken data ring
description: Broken orbital arc on a deliberately offset centre. Offsetting the centres is what keeps the core from reading as concentric rings or an atom mark.
notes: Rotation -21 deg about its own centre. Do not re-centre on the logo.

name: Secondary tilted ring
description: Broken orbital arc on a deliberately offset centre. Offsetting the centres is what keeps the core from reading as concentric rings or an atom mark.
notes: Rotation 31 deg about its own centre. Do not re-centre on the logo.

name: Outer sweep ring
description: Broken orbital arc on a deliberately offset centre. Offsetting the centres is what keeps the core from reading as concentric rings or an atom mark.
notes: Rotation -6 deg about its own centre. Do not re-centre on the logo.

name: Left energy arc
description: Supporting luminous arc sweeping to the left of the focal zone.
notes: Pairs with energy_ring assets.

name: Right wide arc
description: Supporting luminous arc sweeping to the right of the focal zone.
notes: Pairs with energy_ring assets.

name: Machined core tick shell
description: 132 radial micro-ticks forming an engineered perimeter just outside the logo edge. Gives the core a machined, instrument-grade quality rather than a drawn circle.
notes: Radius is tied to the 252pt logo. If the logo size changes, regenerate this asset.

name: Luminous processing nodes
description: Eight signal nodes riding the orbital shell, each with a soft halo. Reads as computation without any literal hardware.
notes: Asymmetric by design.

name: Converging energy streaks
description: Radial support lines converging on the focal zone and terminating clear of the logo edge, so nothing appears to pierce the hero.
notes: Deliberately stops at 1.12x core radius.

name: Hero depth halo
description: Tight radial halo placed immediately behind the Python logo to integrate it into the field and prevent a pasted-on look.
notes: Direct z-neighbour of the logo: halo -> LOGO -> foreground particles.

name: Upper-right topology cluster
description: Graph-topology cluster: nodes plus sparse edges. Restrained ML/network language, never an infographic.
notes: Edge density 42%. Safe-zone filtered.

name: Lower-left topology cluster
description: Graph-topology cluster: nodes plus sparse edges. Restrained ML/network language, never an infographic.
notes: Edge density 42%. Safe-zone filtered.

name: Right-field cluster
description: Graph-topology cluster: nodes plus sparse edges. Restrained ML/network language, never an infographic.
notes: Edge density 42%. Safe-zone filtered.

name: Distant topology web

notes: Intentionally faint; belongs to the blurred depth tier.

name: Luminous plot curve motif
description: A single elegant analytic curve with two sample points — the GRAPH idea expressed as mathematics, with no panel, frame or label.
notes: Component-local. Replaces the banned GRAPH card.

name: Statistical distribution motif
description: A Gaussian point distribution rendered as light — a statistical hint with no axes, chrome or chart furniture.
notes: Component-local. Pairs well with data_nodes_cluster assets.

name: Right code-glyph stream
description: Code fragments drifting along an invisible trajectory — the CODE idea as atmospheric texture rather than a terminal window.
notes: Uses live <text> with a monospace stack. Figma will substitute a font on import — see README 'Known import caveats'. Convert to outlines before print.
